method: Source-reviewed remaining Python Table candidates outside MatrixTable, VDS, plot, and ggplot test trees; requirements identify concrete APIs, formats, algorithms, and observed assertions without execution claims.

tests.implementation_requirement: ServiceBackend must pass configured 8 worker cores and highmem memory through job configuration when range_table(10)._force_count executes.
ServiceBackend must send the configured GCP/Azure region list to the driver job triggered by range_table._force_count, then permit restoring the old region setting.
Executing a two-partition range table must create a named action job group containing one driver job and worker stage groups with expected ancestry and attributes.
Batch backend initialization with an existing batch_id must attach the range_table execution jobs to that same batch and expose its ID and nonzero job count.
SparkBackend must accept an externally owned SparkContext, execute range_table._force_count, and leave that context running after hl.stop.
Annotation DB must look up genomic_range_table rows and expose a unique dataset as struct annotation and nonunique dataset as array of struct annotations.
plot_roc_curve must consume a Table of random scores and boolean TP/FP labels, returning its plot and AUCs for three score fields.
Import LD-score and sum-stat TSVs keyed by SNP; indexed join, annotate locus/alleles, rekey, and count through lowered shuffle without serialization failure.
Union LD-score Tables, convert to phenotype MatrixTable, run block jackknife ld_score_regression, and verify the returned result Table against expected coefficients and errors.
Unlocalize entries from a keyed Table with global columns, sparse-split haploid multiallelic calls, and compare resulting MatrixTable rows/entries with expected LA/LGT/LPL.
Join PCA loadings Table to MatrixTable row allele frequencies, project calls with pc_project, and return one result Table row for each of 100 samples.
full_outer_join_mt on the same VCF MatrixTable must preserve matched column, row, and entry counts through left/right fields.
GCS requester-pays import_table must fail with no billing project configured.
GCS requester-pays range_table.write must fail with no billing project configured, including worker-side access.
GCS requester-pays range_table.write must succeed with the authorized project and allow cleanup.
GCS requester-pays import_table without header must read the single hello row when a billing project is configured.
GCS requester-pays import_table must reject a billing-project configuration scoped to a different bucket.
GCS requester-pays import_table must read ordered lines across at least eight partitions under authorized billing, without seeking beyond stream end.
GCS requester-pays import_table with min_partitions=8 must reject an unauthorized bucket-specific billing configuration.
Load a custom reference from FASTA/FAI; import a TSV and use Table.all with get_sequence(contig,pos) to match bases, plus locus sequence lookup.
Register reciprocal GRCh37/GRCh38 chain files and liftover VCF loci through a MatrixTable rows Table, preserving loci and missing semantics.
read_table of a native Table carrying custom reference metadata must register three reference genomes and preserve a 14-row count.
Write/read a keyed range Table with custom-reference locus values and retain schema, key, globals, and rows under _same.
BlockMatrix.from_entry_expr must apply optional missing-value mean imputation, centering, and normalization to MatrixTable entries and match NumPy arrays.
BlockMatrix.from_entry_expr without imputation must reject a missing MatrixTable entry value.
BlockMatrix.to_table_row_major must emit keyed row_idx and float64 entries arrays matching a parallelized Table, across requested partition and block-size options.
BlockMatrix.to_matrix_table_row_major must generate expected row/column keys and float64 entries for a 2 by 5 array.
BlockMatrix.entries must return a three-field keyed Table (i,j,entry) with all 15 floating elements and _same semantics.
A fully filtered MatrixTable entry with mean imputation must yield a NaN in the BlockMatrix entries Table.
locus_windows on a keyed locus Table must return exact start/stop windows for repeated loci and contig boundaries at radius 1.
locus_windows with row-indexed centimorgan coordinate must return exact start/stop windows at radius 1.0.
locus_windows must reject loci reordered out of ascending genomic order.
locus_windows must reject a coord_expr indexed by a different range_table source.
locus_windows must reject an unindexed constant coord_expr with no Table source.
locus_windows must require row-indexed locus and coordinate expressions, rejecting globals.
locus_windows must raise a user error on missing row locus, with or without coord_expr.
locus_windows must raise on a missing row coordinate expression.
pc_relate on VCF calls must return a keyed pairwise kinship/IBD Table whose kin, ibd0, ibd1, and ibd2 fields match imported R truth within test tolerances.
pc_relate with explicit sample scores must compute expected six pairwise kinship and IBD structs from synthetic genotypes.
import_fam/Pedigree and trio_matrix must align pedigree trios with VCF samples; indexed joins to father/mother Tables and genotype comparisons must agree.
transmission_disequilibrium_test on split multiallelic VCF and pedigree must emit expected T, U, chi_sq, and p_value rows.
de_novo on pedigree-tagged VCF must emit expected proband variants, classifications, and posterior probabilities after Table joins.
VCF import must preserve declared INFO fields and ignore undeclared INFO values/flags; Table rows INFO is defined.
VCF import must tolerate malformed Number metadata for a flag field and count its rows.
VCF import find_replace regex must rewrite RSID columns to missing before parsing; row aggregation confirms all rsid values missing.
VCF import must parse haploid and diploid GT, AD, GQ into entry rows equal to an explicit keyed Table.
VCF import must parse multiple call-typed FORMAT fields, including missing and haploid calls, into entry rows equal to keyed Table truth.
VCF import with GRCh38 and contig recoding must produce chr22 loci after split_multi_hts, with reference-aware locus dtype.
VCF INFO Flag fields NEGATIVE_TRAIN_SITE, POSITIVE_TRAIN_SITE, DB, DS must be defined booleans in every imported row.
VCF INFO array parser with array_elements_required=False must preserve interior missing elements and wholly missing fields with exact row schema.
VCF FORMAT array parser with array_elements_required=False must preserve interior missing AD/PL elements across haploid/diploid entries.
export_vcf must accept a sites-only Table from MatrixTable.rows; reimport must reconstruct a no-entry/no-column MatrixTable equivalent to source.

export_vcf(tabix=True) must write bgzip VCF plus tabix index; its reimport through MatrixVCFReader with explicit genomic partitions must equal ordinary import and filter_intervals must report exact intersected partition counts.

VCF import via MatrixVCFReader with explicit three genomic partition intervals must equal ordinary import; filter_intervals must preserve content while reporting one, two, or three intersected partitions at exact boundaries.
gVCF combiner transform must retain haploid versus diploid GT semantics when localizing entries and combining reference data.
Multi-file VCF import must report mismatched INFO fields with the specified fatal error on row evaluation.
PLINK export/import with a2_reference true/false must swap allele orientation consistently with variant_qc AC/AF through rsid-keyed Table join.
PLINK import must recode chr22 to GRCh37 contig 22, preserve locus type, and row count after VCF export.
export_plink default .fam/.bim output must encode family/sample/sex/phenotype and variant fields; import_table verifies column values.
export_plink custom FAM expressions must emit requested IDs, parents, sex, and binary phenotype encodings.
export_plink float phenotype must emit quantitative values in .fam, distinct from missing and default codes.
export_plink custom varid and centimorgan position must appear in .bim as hello and 100.0.
PLINK export/import must round-trip rows keyed by unreferenced struct locus plus alleles, with calls and sample keys.
BGEN import without decoding entries must skip invalid loci and count three valid rows.
index_bgen must reject invalid loci; import_bgen without a valid index must fail on row count.
BGEN dosage and GP entry fields must agree with gp_dosage computation or both be missing across entries.
BGEN variants filter given literal locus/alleles structs must return exactly requested existing variants and preserve duplicates.
BGEN variants filter by Struct(locus) must return both duplicate rows at position 10000.
BGEN variants filter by Locus objects must return both duplicate rows at position 10000.
BGEN variants filter supplied as its own rows Table must preserve all 199 variants, 500 samples, and row content.
BGEN variants filter supplied as keyed locus Table must return both duplicate rows at position 10000.
GEN/sample import with contig recoding 01 to 1 must yield 199 GRCh37 locus rows.
import_matrix_table TSV must assign declared row-field types and row/column expression axes and execute count.
import_matrix_table of no-column TSV must produce zero columns and 231 rows matching import_table row schema/content.
import_matrix_table comment prefixes # and % must skip matching lines and preserve un-commented matrix content.
import_matrix_table with sep=9 and missing=8 must parse unusual header/row fields and missing entry values exactly, including blank-named key field.
import_matrix_table must parse int64 row field and entry values, returning exact two entry structs.
Matrix entry expression export/import must round-trip keys, typed row fields, missing token, delimiter, and header options across partitions.
import_table(force_bgz=True,impute=True) must read a BGZF file copied to .gz and recover a keyed range Table exactly.
import_table of a wholly empty TSV must raise ValueError with no-lines-after-filters and source path context on collect.
import_table of header-only TSV must produce an empty Table that collects to empty list.
import_table glob over split annotation TSVs must read all files for a 346-row count.
import_table must infer int32, float64, bool, str under custom delimiter/missing token and honor explicit type overrides in schema.
import_table followed by Table.export must reproduce input TSV lines exactly.
import_table(source_file_field) over glob must attach each row's originating file path in source field, preserving file order/index groups.
Table.write/read_table must round-trip unkeyed Table schema, globals, rows, and partition metadata under _same.
Table.write/read_table must round-trip small_dataset_1 after key_by() removes its key, preserving unkeyed schema, globals, and rows under _same.
Two independent import_table calls on the same TSV must be _same.
import_table must attach source/field context to invalid int32 parse and ragged row errors, surfacing HailUserError at count.
read_table(_intervals) must scan native keyed Table after dropping hidden suffix key fields and count interval-restricted rows without failure.
import_bed intervals must support locus containment lookup to annotate VCF rows and match interval-list target assignments.
import_bed and import_locus_intervals must produce equivalent target annotations on MatrixTable rows through interval-indexed lookup.
import_bed with target field must annotate expected gene1/gene2 loci and leave others missing.
maximal_independent_set must choose integer graph nodes with tie breaker, return keyed node:int64 Table, and reject mismatched endpoint type/source or scalar endpoints.
maximal_independent_set on a parallelized edge Table must return an independent node set with node-only row schema and empty globals.
maximal_independent_set must accept struct nodes and expression tie breaker preferring cases, returning case-node IDs.
maximal_independent_set must accept nested struct node identities with floating rank fields and execute count.
maximal_independent_set must apply a float-field tie breaker to struct nodes and honor keep=False.
maximal_independent_set must support string nodes and keep=False, returning one endpoint per disconnected edge.
filter_intervals on VCF rows Table must retain three loci for a single interval or adjacent intervals, accepting Python and Hail arrays of locus intervals.
lambda_gc must estimate genomic-control inflation from scan-generated uniform-like chi-square values, including a nonlinear transform.
lambda_gc must exclude NaN expression values while estimating genomic-control inflation from scan counts.
segment_intervals on a keyed interval Table must split each interval at supplied points, preserve empty interval behavior, and return expected interval ordering.
sample_qc on Table.to_matrix_table calls/GQ/DP must compute per-sample call, genotype, and depth/quality statistics including missing values and haploid calls.
variant_qc on Table.to_matrix_table calls must compute row AC, AF, call rate, genotype counts, and HWE-related fields for multiallelic and missing genotypes.
concordance between two MatrixTables built from parallelized entry Tables must count discordant genotype categories by shared locus/alleles and sample keys.
vep(csq=True) on GRCh37 VCF must produce CSQ arrays matching gnomAD INFO prefixes and global CSQ header text.
vep(csq=True) on GRCh38 VCF must produce CSQ arrays matching gnomAD INFO prefixes and global CSQ header text.
vep(csq=False) on GRCh37 VCF must produce structured annotation whose first row variant_class is SNV.
vep(csq=False) on GRCh38 VCF must produce structured annotation whose first row variant_class is SNV.
vep on GRCh37 VCF rows must match expected Dataproc VEP annotation after normalizing the input field and comparing nested structs.
vep on keyed GRCh38 locus/alleles Table must match imported Dataproc annotation after input-field normalization.
vep on keyed GRCh38 Table must correctly annotate variants with large positions and match expected input normalization.
Linear and logistic SKAT must reject negative variant weights during result Table evaluation.
Logistic SKAT must reject a phenotype outside the binary 0/1 domain during result Table evaluation.
Logistic SKAT with unit weights must return Q statistic and Davies p-value matching R SKAT truth.
Logistic SKAT with variant weights must return Q statistic and Davies p-value matching R SKAT truth.
Logistic SKAT over imported genotype matrix must match R truth for large-group Q and p-value.
Linear SKAT with covariates and unit weights must match R truth Q and p-value.
Linear SKAT with covariates and weighted variants must match R truth Q and p-value.
Linear SKAT over imported genotype matrix must match R truth Q and p-value for large-group data.
Linear SKAT with VCF, sample covariates/phenotypes, interval-assigned gene groups, and locus weights must match legacy Scala result rows.
impute_sex on VCF calls must reproduce PLINK sex assignments and F-statistics after joining imported truth Table by sample.
linear_regression_rows on VCF dosages and joined phenotype/covariate Tables must match known beta, standard error, t-statistic, and p-values.
linear_regression_rows pass_through row fields must retain nested struct values exactly through keyed result Table lookup.
linear_regression_rows with multiple phenotypes/covariates must match chained single regressions, including missing phenotype masks and array result fields.
linear_regression_rows without intercept must match expected coefficient statistics for VCF call counts.
linear_regression_rows with sample covariates from imported Tables must match expected coefficient and p-value rows.
linear_regression_rows on pl_dosage from VCF PL arrays must match known result rows.
linear_regression_rows on gp_dosage from imported GEN must match known result rows.
linear_regression_rows using dosage versus GT allele counts must return nearly equal p-values, including NaN-aware comparison.
linear_regression_rows must consume boolean phenotype imported from FAM and match expected statistics.
linear_regression_rows must consume quantitative phenotype imported from FAM and match expected statistics.
Multi-phenotype linear_regression_rows must equal separate per-phenotype runs, handling NaN values.
_linear_regression_rows_nd weighted coefficients must agree with preweighted data and hl.agg.linreg, including NaN handling.
_linear_regression_rows_nd must exclude samples with missing weights and agree with weighted hl.agg.linreg.
logistic_regression_rows Wald test must match known beta, standard error, z-statistic, and p-value for VCF calls.
Multi-phenotype logistic_regression_rows Wald results must match separate phenotype runs and output array fields.
Multi-phenotype logistic_regression_rows on BGEN dosage must match single-phenotype fits and expected statistics after sample Table joins.
logistic_regression_rows Wald test on pl_dosage from VCF PL must match known statistics.
logistic_regression_rows Wald test on gp_dosage from GEN must match known statistics.
logistic_regression_rows likelihood-ratio test must match known chi-square and p-values for VCF calls.
logistic_regression_rows score test must match known chi-square and p-values for VCF calls.
logistic_regression_rows pass_through must preserve a nested row struct through keyed Table lookup.
poisson_regression_rows Wald test must match known beta, standard error, z-statistic, and p-value.
poisson_regression_rows likelihood-ratio test must match known chi-square and p-value.
poisson_regression_rows score test must match known chi-square and p-value.
poisson_regression_rows pass_through must preserve a nested row struct through keyed Table lookup.
row_correlation on Table.to_matrix_table synthetic calls must match the hard-coded correlation matrix with missing genotypes.
split_multi_hts on multiallelic VCF must produce expected biallelic rows/calls versus truth.
split_multi on VCF rows Table must produce the same biallelic row content as split_multi_hts on MatrixTable.
split_multi on unsorted keyed Table with permit_shuffle=True must reorder alleles A/C, A/G, A/T and agree with MatrixTable splitting.
ld_prune must emit variant Table whose retained loci satisfy genotype-correlation threshold and expected count after split_multi_hts.
ld_prune must apply minor-allele-frequency filter alongside r2 pruning to simulated variants and match expected retained count.
balding_nichols_model must generate expected row/column counts, allele frequencies, and genotype statistics for fixed randomness.
de_novo on VCF calls/pedigree must emit a variant/sample Table whose classifications and posterior values match imported truth.
split_multi_hts on a Table of haploid multiallelic calls must downcode GT and PL correctly and return expected row structs.
With use_fast_restarts=1 and a configured cachedir, executing an annotated range Table must create a nonempty execution-cache folder in backend FS.
A divide-by-zero in a randomly annotated ten-partition Table must surface a worker-side FatalError with Java floorDiv and BackendUtils stack frames.
Out-of-bounds array indexing in a Table.filter expression must surface HailUserError upon count, not an unclassified backend failure.
